title: SAT Math Faculty - Part Time Consultant
jobDescription:
We are looking for an SAT Faculty for Math to lead our SAT Plus program. SAT Plus is an online live learning program through which students around the world can learn from highly qualified and trained faculty. The charter for this role will include: ● Conducting remote SAT Quant coaching sessions for individual students via video conferencing platforms ● Providing detailed feedback and progress reports to students and their parents/guardians. ● Keeping up-to-date with SAT exam changes and trends to ensure the curriculum remains relevant and effective. ● Maintaining communication with students and parents/guardians to address concerns and provide support as needed. The best candidate will tick all OR many boxes : ● Minimum 3 months of experience teaching SAT. ● Technologically savvy
- you are confident handling Zoom, Whatsapp, etc ● Confidence and flair to handle large audiences Working Days and Time : ● 6 days a week with Mondays or Tuesdays off on a rotational basis. ● Timings: 6:00 PM – 11:00 PM

title: Education Coach

title: IELTS Trainer - Part Time Consultant
jobDescription: About Leap Leap has helped 300,000+ students achieve their study abroad dreams across 25+ countries . With 700+ university partnerships and backing from leading global investors, our mission is to make quality international education accessible to every ambitious student. About the Role We're expanding our IELTS training presence in Chennai through our network of partner colleges and are looking for a passionate IELTS Trainer . This is a field-based role where you will travel to assigned partner colleges across Chennai to conduct IELTS preparation classes, workshops, and study abroad seminars. Roles & Responsibilities Visit assigned partner colleges across Chennai to conduct IELTS preparation classes. Deliver IELTS and study abroad awareness seminars and workshops on college campuses. Assess students' English proficiency and provide personalized feedback. Conduct mock IELTS tests and track student progress. Guide students on effective test-taking strategies and exam techniques. Motivate and mentor students throughout their IELTS preparation journey. Build strong relationships with partner college stakeholders to ensure smooth program delivery. Counsel interested students and support enrollments into Leap's IELTS programs. Ideal Persona 1–3 years of experience in IELTS or English language training. Excellent communication, presentation, and classroom management skills. Comfortable traveling across Chennai to conduct classes and seminars at partner colleges. Passionate about teaching, mentoring students, and driving learning outcomes. Self-motivated, organized, and adaptable to a field-based role

title: UG Counselling
jobDescription: We are looking for an Associate – UG Premium Counseling who will play a critical role in delivering high-quality, personalized counselling services to undergraduate aspirants targeting top global universities. This is a client-facing, outcome-driven role requiring deep expertise in undergraduate admissions, strong stakeholder management skills, and the ability to independently handle high-value student portfolios The charter for this role will include : Own end-to-end premium counselling for undergraduate students aspiring to study abroad (US, UK, Canada, Europe, etc.) Conduct in-depth profile evaluations and craft personalized admissions strategies Guide students on: Academic and extracurricular profile building College shortlisting and application strategy Essays, SOPs, LORs, and application narratives Drive admissions outcomes by ensuring quality, timeliness, and strategic rigor Manage a portfolio of high-intent, premium clients with strong service ownership Manage submissions across application platforms like Common APP, UCAS, UC and Others Maintain high standards of client satisfaction and conversion Collaborate with internal teams (sales, ops, content, product) to improve counselling experience Coordinate with Expert mentors to align mentored-student projects like research or capstone Stay updated on global admissions trends, policies, and university requirements Ideal Persona : 2–5+ years of experience in undergraduate admissions counselling, preferably in premium/Ivy League-focused markets Strong understanding of global UG admissions ecosystems Proven success in handling high-value students and complex profiles Excellent written and verbal communication skills Familiarity with application portals across countries Ability to operate independently with high ownership and accountability Project management skills to guide and track students on various high school projects Exposure to process design, tools, or tech-enabled counselling platforms is a plus Background in premium education consulting firms or international education startups Everyone at Leap is entrepreneurial, moves fast and operates with extreme ownership. There is minimal management and extreme autonomy. If the above defines you, you will fit in snugly. What is Leap? Leap is a global student mobility platform that empowers students’ aspirations for a global career and education We have built Leap Finance and Leap Scholar and Yocket We work at the exciting intersection of fintech & edtech And we love that we succeed as a business while powering the dreams of talented students! Who are we as people? We have a lean, rockstar team. We have come this far with a lean team because we love to increase the talent density with every new member we add. Yes, we are more picky than the usual company. We hire slowly and deliberately You can meet our founders here -> Arnav Kumar and Vaibhav Singh What will you be doing? Broadly, You will have tearing-your-hair level complex & challenging problems to solve With massive upside if you solve them In a super fast paced environment that will challenge you With enough resources to be audacious And mentorship from an experienced founding team

title: SDE - 1
jobDescription:
RESPONSIBILITIES:
Define, design, develop, integrate, test, deploy, maintain, troubleshoot, and enhance applications and tools written in Java, Swift, or relevant programming languages. Develop components using Java, J2EE technologies, and other relevant frameworks. Build RESTful APIs using My SQL/Postgre SQL databases and Python/Django. Prototype models using high-level modeling languages like R or Python. Refactor old Python code to ensure adherence to modern principles. Create secure RESTful-based web services using XML, JSON, and relevant scripting languages. Utilize software engineering skills such as Java, Spark, Python, and Scala for development tasks. Requirements: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field. 1-3 years of experience in software development with proficiency in Java, Python, or relevant languages. Strong understanding of object-oriented design principles and high-level programming concepts. Experience in developing APIs using Java, Python, Node.js, and implementing microservices. Familiarity with SQL, Power Shell, and intermediate skills in Python. Knowledge of automation tools like Maven, Test NG, and API automation. Hands-on experience with databases such as Mongo DB, My SQL, or similar. Excellent coding skills in Python, R, Spark, and other relevant interfaces. Ability to work on both front-end and back-end technologies using Java frameworks. Understanding of web application development and integration using HTML, Java EE, and related technologies.
